folder: A Plan to Stop AI from Automating Our Decline
title: A Plan to Stop AI from Automating Our Decline
speaker: Gina Raimondo
summary_zh: 前美国商务部长 Gina Raimondo 提出一个尖锐观点：如果美国赢得 AI 技术竞赛却让数百万工人失业，那就是「自动化了自己的衰落」。她主张技术战略必须与人力资本战略并行，才能让全民共享 AI 经济红利。
summary_en: Former US Secretary of Commerce Gina Raimondo argues that winning the AI technology race while displacing millions of workers would mean "automating our own decline." She calls for a dual strategy: leading in tech while bringing everyone along to an AI-powered economy.
aliases: A Plan to Stop AI from Automating Our Decline
